title: Nature Sunnah — Holistic Wellness & Adventure Booking Platform
desc: A complete redesign of a Dutch holistic wellness e-commerce site, combining a WooCommerce webshop for raw honey, black seed oil, and natural supplements with a dynamic adventure-booking system for ice bath workshops, Morocco horse-riding trips, and Ardennes camping experiences.
problem: The client's existing site was slow, converting poorly, and structurally confusing — the product grid only displayed two products, the mobile homepage buttons didn't work, and there was no system for managing adventure trips with or without confirmed dates. The client also wanted their WhatsApp-only support replaced with an AI chatbot and needed a dedicated, on-site charity donation page instead of redirecting elsewhere.
solution: Restructured the entire navigation into five focused menus (Adventure, Webshop, Honey, About Us, Contact) and rebuilt the homepage around a 7-category adventure grid. Built dynamic pricing and date fields for each trip, and integrated Kit.com so trips without a confirmed date automatically show a 'Join Waitlist' form instead of 'Book Now.' Fixed the WooCommerce product grid bug limiting visible products, added 9 new webshop categories, and implemented an order-bump feature at checkout (e.g., suggesting a wooden honey spoon with honey purchases). Created a dedicated TIPS-model (Tempt, Influence, Persuade, Sell) sales page for the ice bath workshop with direct checkout, replaced the WhatsApp button with an AI chatbot, and resolved mobile responsiveness and site-speed issues so core ordering worked reliably on phones on day one.
result: Delivered a fully responsive, high-converting wellness and adventure platform where customers can browse and purchase natural products or book adventure experiences seamlessly, with an automated waitlist-to-booking flow, a working multi-product shop grid, and restored critical mobile ordering functionality within the client's first-day deadline.

title: I.G.B. Entertainment — Wedding DJ Website SEO & Performance Optimization
desc: An ongoing SEO, performance, and accessibility overhaul for a Northern Virginia-based wedding DJ company's existing WordPress/Elementor site, focused on fixing technical debt, restructuring heading hierarchy, and building out local SEO foundations across multiple client revision cycles.
problem: The client's live WordPress site had broken internal links and 404 errors flagged by Semrush, duplicate navigation markup hurting crawl efficiency, incorrect heading hierarchy (headings used as styled text boxes instead of proper H1–H3 tags), missing image alt text/titles/captions, no structured data (schema) for local business or FAQs, no dedicated location/service pages, form spam and email deliverability issues, Google Site Health critical warnings (plugin auto-updates, background updates), and social share previews not pulling an image when the link was shared.
solution: Ran a full on-page and technical SEO audit and resolved it in phases: corrected heading hierarchy (single H1, structured H2/H3 across services and FAQ sections), rewrote meta titles/descriptions, added image alt text and captions, fixed sitemap and robots.txt configuration, resolved 404s and broken internal links, removed the duplicate header/navigation code, configured SMTP with the client's Google Workspace to stop spam and fix form email delivery, set up an Open Graph share image so social links preview correctly, addressed Google PageSpeed accessibility issues (frame titles, discernible link names, sequential heading order), resolved WordPress Site Health critical issues, and restructured service offerings into dedicated pages (Bilingual DJ, Wedding DJ Package, Special Events/Budget-Friendly DJ) with FAQ accordions and a service-area map section — all delivered through several rounds of client-driven revisions and QC.
result: Delivered a cleaner, better-indexed WordPress site with corrected heading structure, a spam-free and reliably delivering contact form, fixed 404s/broken links, working social share previews, a 90+ Google PageSpeed accessibility score, resolved Site Health critical issues, and a structured local SEO foundation (schema-ready service pages, optimized metadata, service-area targeting for Northern Virginia, DC, and Maryland) — maintained through ongoing client revision rounds and ready to scale with future blog and location-page content.

archDetails.backend: WordPress core with Elementor/Elementor Pro, Classic Editor, WP Rocket for caching and performance, image optimization (Imagify), and SMTP integration via Google Workspace for reliable contact-form email delivery.

title: Met Club E-Learning Platform — Gamified Disaster Preparedness Learning App
desc: A full-stack, story-driven e-learning web platform commissioned under Save the Children, built to teach children weather, climate, and disaster-preparedness concepts through interactive stories, animated illustrations, and gamified quizzes. The platform is now featured on the Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD) website as an official learning resource.
problem: Save the Children needed a structured, engaging way to teach children a large, technical disaster-risk-reduction curriculum (36 topics across weather, hydrology, geology, and disaster response) without it feeling like a dry textbook. The content needed to translate story-based, illustration-heavy source material into an interactive digital experience with quizzes, drag-and-drop activities, hotspot clicks, and sequencing games — built to a standard credible enough to be featured on a government meteorological agency's website.
solution: Built a full-stack learning platform from scratch under Save the Children, with a React + TypeScript frontend using Framer Motion (and other animation libraries) to bring the story characters and scenes to life, and a Node.js/Express backend with Prisma ORM on PostgreSQL to handle structured content delivery, module/session sequencing, and quiz-result data. Converted the source curriculum (36 sub-topics grouped into 9 core modules — weather & climate, water systems, ecosystems, earth structure, water/weather disasters, geo/fire disasters, risk mapping, climate change, preparedness & post-disaster response) into interactive lessons, implementing multiple gamified question types (hotspot click, true/false, fill-in-the-blank, drag-and-drop matching, sequence arrangement, and multiple choice) matching the original instructional design.
result: Shipped a live, fully functional gamified learning platform (meteorologyclub.com) that delivers the entire 3-month, 15-session disaster-preparedness curriculum through interactive stories and mini-games. The project was adopted by the Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD) and is now linked/featured on the official BMD website as a recognized disaster-education resource, with a type-safe React frontend and a scalable Express/Prisma/PostgreSQL backend supporting ongoing curriculum expansion.

archDetails.frontend: React with TypeScript for type-safe component development, animation libraries (e.g. Framer Motion) for story transitions, character animations, and interactive quiz elements (hotspot clicks, drag-and-drop, sequencing).
archDetails.backend: Node.js with Express serving REST APIs for curriculum content, session/module structure, and quiz submission handling.
archDetails.database: PostgreSQL managed through Prisma ORM, modeling modules, sessions, topics, learning outcomes, and quiz/question data for structured content delivery.

title: PPFS — Financial Advisory Website Redesign & Client Portal Integration
desc: A complete WordPress website redesign and hosting migration for an Irish financial advisory firm, featuring interactive seven-tier Personal and Business planning pages, an embedded client portal, adviser booking links, and consultation forms connected to authenticated email delivery.
problem: The client needed a fully working replacement for an existing financial services website, using an approved reference design and updated company copy under a tight launch deadline. solution: Rebuilt the site on WordPress with Elementor and Elementor Pro, following the supplied reference while updating the copy and layouts across Home, Personal, Business, Our Approach, Meet Our Team, Community Support, Client Services, Contact, consultation forms, and legal pages. Migrated the site to Cloudways, coordinated DNS and SSL setup, retained existing legal URLs used in printed QR codes, and refined mobile PDF display, headshot cropping, card alignment, typography, and a reusable footer banner through repeated client reviews.
result: Delivered a live financial advisory website with clear Personal and Business planning journeys, client portal access, adviser booking links, downloadable advisory documents, and form submissions reaching the sales mailbox.
